subject: Sentinel Health — model tune backlash: throughput & latency hit
messages:
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@sentinelhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden throughput drop after July model tune

Hi Logan,

We pushed the July model tune your team recommended on Friday (switched to the new v2.3 quant profile). Since then we've seen our p95 latency jump by ~2.5x and a sustained drop in throughput — timeouts creeping into production pipelines. Error rate on streaming endpoints is also up (sample attached).

This is blocking a morning batch that feeds our care-coordination service. We're paused on production usage until we understand what's happening. Can you please escalate internally and tell me:

- Do you see the same behavior on your side?
- Is there a quick rollback path to previous profile?
- ETA for a fix or mitigation?

I attached a small set of traces and a few example requests that reproduce the failure consistently. We need an executive sync if this drags >24h.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director of Engineering, Sentinel Health
[Attachment: latency_traces.zip]

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden throughput drop after July model tune

Daniel —

We're onboarding this as a high-priority incident. Thanks for the traces, those are already helpful. Quick answers:

- We're seeing elevated p95 on a small subset of tenants after the v2.3 quant profile rollout; diagnostics are running.
- We can immediately roll back a customer's quant profile to the previous stable variant; that's our short-term mitigation.
- Karthik will lead the technical investigation and propose a patch or canary change by EOD.

Proposed next steps (I'll coordinate):
1) Warm rollback to the stable quant profile for Sentinel (immediate)
2) Live triage call in 30 minutes to walk through traces (please confirm availability)
3) Exec update if rollback doesn't clear the issue in 2 hours

Monica — please own exec communications and any credits/contract asks. Karthik — can you confirm the kernel/quant combo and whether a hotfix is feasible without wider rollback?

Logan
Head of Customer Escalations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden throughput drop after July model tune

Logan / team —

Initial findings from the traces Daniel sent:
- The v2.3 quant profile changes kernel selection for certain attention paths. For medium-length sequences (~512 tokens) we hit a less-optimized code path that increases per-token latency under high concurrency.
- There's also a KV-cache alignment mismatch that causes extra mem copies for a subset of request shapes; this spikes tail latency and pushes some worker threads into backpressure.

Short-term options:
- Rollback Sentinel to v2.2 quant profile at 09:55 PT (minimal customer impact).
- Patch: adjust kernel selection whitelist and fix the KV alignment in the runtime; estimate ~6-8 hours to build, test, and stage a hotfix. If we prioritize and cut corners on perf tests we could aim for ~4h but with higher risk.

Risk assessment:
- Full rollback removes risk quickly but costs a small regeneration of cached prefixes (brief cold starts).
- Hotfix keeps Sentinel on v2.3 but needs careful canarying; potential to introduce regressions if rushed.

I'll start the rollback plan now and spin a canary build in parallel. Will post play-by-play to the incident doc (link in related_links).

-Karthik
Principal Engineer, Inference Runtime
[Attachment: error_samples.txt]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden throughput drop after July model tune

Hi Daniel —

I'm very sorry you're seeing this. We understand the production impact and are prioritizing your account. Per Logan and Karthik: we will perform an immediate rollback for you and run the hotfix path in parallel.

Two asks so we can move faster:
- Can you confirm the top 3 busiest routes you saw errors on (endpoint names or example prompts)?
- Do you want an exec call with Redwood's CTO and our VP of Product now or only if rollback doesn't clear the issue?

We will also prepare a credit proposal for the time impacted and include that in the postmortem. I will own the customer-facing communications and will schedule an exec sync if you confirm.

Best,
Monica Patel
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sentinel_contract.pdf]

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Jul 2026 17:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden throughput drop after July model tune — final update

Daniel —

Status update and resolution summary:
- At 09:55 PT on 2026-07-28 we rolled Sentinel back to the v2.2 quant profile; visible latency and error-rate regressed to baseline within ~18 minutes.
- Karthik's team delivered a targeted hotfix for the kernel selection + KV alignment at 14:30 PT on 2026-07-29; we ran an internal canary and validated reduced p95 under your sample workload.
- We have not promoted the hotfix to full production for all customers yet; we'll coordinate a staged rollout with you if you'd like to test on a non-critical subset first.

Actions and next steps:
- Monica will send formal compensation details and a postmortem (target: 2026-08-02).
- Karthik to provide a technical change log and a recommended canary configuration for Sentinel.
- Lauren will coordinate a postmortem meeting with Sentinel's ops and product teams early next week.

If you'd like an exec call, we're ready to schedule with our CTO; otherwise we'll continue via the incident doc and the postmortem deliverable. Thank you for your patience and detailed traces — they helped a lot.

Regards,
Logan Wright
Head of Customer Escalations
Redwood Inference
